name: crescendo-r1
description: crescendo room 1 only (launch at questRoom 1); same steps as in crescendo-full.
notes: crescendo route for an S-rank attempt (rank = combat score only; solo deathless). UNVERIFIED live.

Native SM64 input only. Encounters start by walking the follow participant into their original trigger volume; far spawn clusters are walked and fought; the required trigger is re-walked before each door; rooms exit through use-door (B at the unlocked exit door, original portal path).
Fight plan is automatic (required encounter = wave, other = fight, last room = boss). Quest-specific mechanics (switches, carry objects, special doors) are NOT planned yet.
MarioQaImmortal is for unattended QA only: run an S-rank attempt with Run-MarioRoute.ps1 -NoQaImmortal.

steps.note: wave sweeps until the room advances
